name: TPK-POOL — Svc.TlmPacketizer membership pool (issue 6431)
deployment: Any deployment whose telemetry sender `tlmSend` is Svc.TlmPacketizer and whose packet set holds the three test packets of §0; venue named in the manifest and bench.json, not here

not_covered_ack: setPacketList overflow, packet-count and size-mismatch asserts: reaching them needs a different image (UT death tests cover them)
per-packet override reload, mirror-allocation failure, oversized-channel paths: unchanged by this issue, covered by the existing unit tests
coverage.rationale: System threshold lowered from 75 to 50: the change is an internal storage layout; most of the component (override persistence, rate logic) is outside this plan and already unit-tested. UT 95 because every assert branch is forced on the host.

scope: - Venue-neutral by ruling (ledger 14): tests use only `tlmSend`, `cmdDisp` and `version` commands, events and channels. Venues for the runs: fprime-zephyr-reference on bench hardware (prime), Ref on a Linux host (fallback); both recorded per run.

- Test deployment delta (same in every venue, uncommitted to the UUT): `tlmSend` is `Svc.TlmPacketizer`; packet set adds `TpkA` id 60 and `TpkB` id 61, each holding `cmdDisp.CommandsDispatched` (one channel, two memberships), and `TpkC` id 62 holding only `cmdDisp.CommandsDropped`; all three in group 1.
- Out of scope: the build-time sizing check (pytest in `cmake/test`, not a system test); rate logic and override persistence (unchanged).
entry_gates: - Stage-1 close: `fprime-util check` on `Svc/TlmPacketizer` passes with every unit-test row of the SDD implemented.
- Marker round-trip: `CMD_NO_OP_STRING("<n>")` returns `NoOpStringReceived` byte-exact through the archive.
- Image built from the manifest SHAs; dictionary from that build.
levels: L0 provenance/feasibility · L2 functional · L6 negative controls · L7 final state. L3 (reset), L4 (endurance) and L5 (fault paths) have no test: the change has no persistent state, no timing requirement, and its only fault path is a boot assert that needs a different image.

TPK-013.note: Accept side seen at L0-2 (the image boots and sends with a two-membership channel); the assert side needs an image that overflows the pool, which is a different build, so it is a unit death test. No second planted-fault-disjoint system test is possible.

tests.title: Image identity
tests.purpose: Shows the running image is the one built from the manifest's commits.
tests.evidence: Version events equal to the manifest's describe strings.

tests.title: Packet list accepted at boot
tests.purpose: Shows a packet list with a channel in two packets is accepted and packets flow.
tests.evidence: TpkA samples inside the window; no NoChan event.

tests.title: Channel value reaches its first packet
tests.purpose: Shows a channel update is stored in, and downlinked by, the first packet that lists it.

rationale.text: TpkB is held back for the window, so a CommandsDispatched sample after PacketSent(60) can only come from TpkA

tests.evidence: PacketSent(60) once, then a CommandsDispatched sample whose value counts the window's commands.

tests.title: Channel value reaches its second packet
tests.purpose: Shows the same channel update is also stored in the second packet that lists it.

rationale.text: TpkA is held back for the window, so the sample can only come from TpkB, the channel's second membership

tests.evidence: PacketSent(61) once, then a CommandsDispatched sample equal to the dispatcher's own count.

tests.title: Unknown packet is refused
tests.purpose: Shows a send request for an unknown packet is reported and sends nothing.

tests.title: Final state
tests.purpose: Leaves both test packets enabled and shows each still carries the channel.
tests.evidence: PacketSent(60) and PacketSent(61); the last CommandsDispatched sample equals the count of OpCodeDispatched events the ground archive holds since boot (independent of the packetizer).

final_state.rationale: The component has no stored state to dump; the auditor recomputes the expected CommandsDispatched value from the archived OpCodeDispatched events, a path that does not pass through the packetizer's channel storage.

not_covered: - TPK-013 assert side, and every other setPacketList assert: needs a different image; unit death tests.
- Memory saved by the pool: not observable through commands or telemetry; shown by the SDD sizing table and the build's map file (inspection).
- The build-time sizing check: verified by pytest in `cmake/test` and a compile-failure fixture, not on a bench.
- TPK-002, 004..012: unchanged behavior, existing unit tests; no system test added by this issue.
decision_log: 1. 2026-11-23 approver — venue: fprime-zephyr-reference on bench hardware, fallback Ref on a Linux host (ledger 12).
2. 2026-11-23 approver — tests run in both venues; the venue is a run artifact and stays out of the SDD (ledger 14).
3. 2026-11-23 designer — marker = `cmdDisp.CMD_NO_OP_STRING`; no tester component is added.
4. 2026-11-23 designer — test packets TpkA/TpkB/TpkC are added to the test deployment only; for the approver at gate 1.
5. 2026-11-23 designer — system coverage threshold 50 % lines (see coverage.rationale); for the design review and gate 1.
